title: Asset transfer instructions
description: Instructs an institution to transfer or sell an estate asset under the grant.
guidance:
Write to an institution that holds an estate asset (a share registry, a bank, a super fund, a vehicle registry). We act for the executors (or administrators).

- Identify the deceased, the grant and its date, and the asset, using only details the matter's documents give (holder or account number, description, quantity). Use a placeholder for any detail that isn't in them.
- Say what the executors instruct: to transfer the asset to a named person, or to sell it and pay the proceeds to the estate, exactly as the lawyer's instructions say. If the instructions don't say which, use a placeholder.
- List what is enclosed only if the instructions say so (for example a certified copy of the grant or a signed transfer form), and ask for any forms they need.
- Ask them to confirm when it is done.
